commentary: Revenue for August came in at [[revenue.month.actual]], above budget by [[revenue.month.vs_budget]] ([[revenue.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[revenue.month.vs_py]] ([[revenue.month.vs_py_pct]]), while direct costs at [[direct_costs.month.actual]] ran above budget by [[direct_costs.month.vs_budget]] ([[direct_costs.month.vs_budget_pct]]), leaving gross profit of [[gross_profit.month.actual]] below budget by [[gross_profit.month.vs_budget]] ([[gross_profit.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and gross margin at [[gross_margin.month.actual]], down 4.0 percentage points on budget and down 3.5 percentage points on last year. Operating profit for August was [[operating_profit.month.actual]], below budget by [[operating_profit.month.vs_budget]] ([[operating_profit.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and slightly down on last year by [[operating_profit.month.vs_py]] ([[operating_profit.month.vs_py_pct]]). Year to date, revenue of [[revenue.ytd.actual]] is above budget by [[revenue.ytd.vs_budget]] ([[revenue.ytd.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[revenue.ytd.vs_py]] ([[revenue.ytd.vs_py_pct]]), with operating profit of [[operating_profit.ytd.actual]] above budget by [[operating_profit.ytd.vs_budget]] ([[operating_profit.ytd.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[operating_profit.ytd.vs_py]] ([[operating_profit.ytd.vs_py_pct]]). On clients, Orchard Lane Foods contributed [[client.orchard-lane.revenue.month.actual]] in August, [[client.orchard-lane.share.month.actual]] of agency revenue and above its May to July average by [[client.orchard-lane.revenue.month.vs_avg3m]] ([[client.orchard-lane.revenue.month.vs_avg3m_pct]]), while Marlow & Finch billed [[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.actual]] in August, below its May to July average by [[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.vs_avg3m]] ([[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.vs_avg3m_pct]]) and now [[client.marlow-finch.share.month.actual]] of August revenue against [[client.marlow-finch.share.ytd.actual]] year to date. The owner may wish to review the Marlow & Finch position given the size of that August drop against its recent run rate.
